title: A simulation neither creates nor kills an observer

statements.text: Starting a computer simulation of an agent does not bring an observer into existence, and shutting it down does not in general end the simulated agent's experience. What a simulation changes is the algorithmic probability of the agent's future states.

sources.quote: starting a computer simulation does not “bring an observer into existence”, and shutting down a simulation does not “kill” the simulated observer
shutting down computer simulations does not generally terminate its inhabitants
